mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when RSAFS is above its 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% triggers a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO growth > 0.5% annually), a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY and UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO growth > 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,300,000 units signals a weakening housing market, which is a key component of consumer spending and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as robust manufacturing output signals strong economic activity and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO is above its 1-year moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is consistently below 0.03.
